plan.failureSummary: Deterministic replay failed because the survey form fields changed (e.g. 'Your Name' instead of 'Last Name'), causing cached page.ai selectors to fail.
observedIndicators: Failure occurred during cache replay in DETERMINISTIC mode (isRetryAttempt = false).
Cached instructions attempted to target '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']' and label 'Last Name *'.
Live failure screenshot shows the form now displays 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *' instead of separate first/last name fields.
Browser error logs are empty and the application rendered normally.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and re-run test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached Page.AI file for tests/unstable-survey.test.ts and re-run the test to allow autonomous regeneration of the survey interaction steps.

plan.notes: The test instruction 'Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...' is semantically flexible. Regenerating the Page.AI cache will allow autonomous execution to adapt to the new form inputs.
